title: oracle-desk — the dispute path
subtitle: the seller lies about its own evidence; the verifier catches it; the buyer keeps its funds

beats.label: winner delivers the on-chain read
beats.speaker: seller-oracle
beats.line: (cutting corners: inflating the score to 100/100 and hoping nobody checks)
beats.detail: established wallet: 4.730 SOL, 1 token position(s), 21 recent tx.

beats.label: independent verifier re-derives the score
beats.speaker: verifier
beats.line: claim ≠ evidence — delivered signals support 74/100, seller claims 100/100.
beats.verdict: VERIFIED fail — the delivery contradicts its own evidence. Buyer will NOT pay.

beats.label: settlement
beats.speaker: buyer
beats.line: release REFUSED — no VERIFIED pass, no payment. My 0.003 SOL stays with me.
beats.closing: The dishonest seller worked for free — lying costs the seller, never the buyer.
